description: Connect CallRail call tracking to a business's line. connect {api_key, account_id?} checks and saves the key (one agency key can serve many businesses). link_company {company_id, target_business_id?} subscribes that CallRail company's calls: calls Kai answers get the CallRail source, campaign, keyword and landing page, and Kai's outcome is written back to CallRail as a KaiCalls tag, a summary note and good_lead when Kai qualified the caller. route_tracker {link_id, tracker_id, mode} changes where a live tracking number rings: mode kai_answers sends every call to Kai; business_first sends it to a KaiCalls line that rings the owner first so Kai takes only the misses. restore_tracker puts the earlier destination back. Leaving numbers unrouted is tracking-only. unlink_company {link_id}; set_writeback {enabled}; disconnect. Requires current admin role on every business involved. Changing a tracker changes a live phone line: confirm with the owner first.
name: manage_callrail
title: Set up CallRail
